S01: In a quiet Italian village lived a brother and sister, with only three sheep for their inheritance.
S02: The brother and sister lived in harmony and cared for the sheep.
S03: Their father had left them three sheep — all they had.
S04: One day the brother set out for the market to sell the sheep.
S05: On the way he met a stranger, and beside him three strong dogs.
S06: The man said: "These are marvelous creatures."
S07: Kinisinđir, Kršizid and Vitkaǯelezo — so the three dogs were called.
S08: The man offered to trade his sheep for the three dogs.
S09: The boy hesitated long, but in the end he accepted the offer.
S10: With the three dogs, he returned home.
S11: But the sister grew angry when she saw.
S12: Sister: "You gave away our only wealth! For three useless dogs!"
S13: And so she drove him from the house.
S14: He walked long, until in the distance he sighted a splendid palace.
S15: The palace was empty and abandoned, but it shone as if alive.
S16: The brother resolved to live here, and lived like a prince.
S17: The thresholds were marble, and dust danced in the light.
S19: For days he ate from golden plates and slept in soft chambers.
S21: In the garden stood a strange apple tree, with a single golden apple.
S22: Being happy, the brother invited his sister to live with him.
S23: And again they lived well, until one day.
S24: Then from the sky descended the Dragon with seven heads.
S25: The seven heads hissed, and smoke curled from his nostrils.
S26: The frightened girl shrank back before the dragon.
S27: Sister: "Have mercy! Eat my brother, but spare me!"
S28: Dragon: "Good! But first you shall do as I tell you."
S29: Sister: "Your dogs stink! Take them outside!"
S30: The brother, ever kind, tied the dogs outside.
S31: Sister (from the window): "Since you're already in the garden, bring me an apple!"
S32: He obeyed and picked an apple.
S33: Then the dragon appeared again and fell upon the boy.
S34: Brother: "Kinisinđir, Kršizid and Vitkaǯelezo, help me!"
S35: In an instant, the dogs tore the chains asunder and broke the walls.
S36: The dragon, frightened, fled with lightning speed.
S37: The brother embraced his faithful dogs.
S38: Peace reigned again in the garden.
S39: Then the apple tree opened, and a strong light blazed from it.
S40: From the light came forth a beautiful maiden.
S41: Maiden: "I am the mistress of this palace. You have finally freed me from the spell!"
S42: The brother could not believe his eyes.
S43: The palace came alive — color returned, and the spell was broken.
S44: Now you shall live with me, said the girl.
S45: The palace sang with joy, lit as never before.
S46: Their hands joined, and their gazes met.
S47: And they lived in happiness and harmony, forever.
S48: Thus, kindness and faithful friends always prevail.
